title: Generative AI on AWS
description: Pick the Bedrock feature, agent service or AWS GenAI tool that fits each Cairnway requirement.

cards.prompt: Try foundation models from several providers through one API, without managing any servers.
Let the shopping assistant answer from Cairnway's own return-policy documents in S3, with managed retrieval (RAG).
Stop the shopping assistant from giving medical advice and mask customers' phone numbers in its answers.
Run Cairnway's customer-service agent in production with session isolation, memory and identity, whatever framework it was built with.
Write an AI agent in code with an open-source toolkit from AWS, where the model decides which tools to call.
cards.why: Strands Agents is the open-source toolkit you build the agent with. AgentCore is where you run and operate it.

cards.prompt: Help Cairnway's developers plan, write and review the shop's code with an agentic AI tool used in their IDE and command line.
Modernize Cairnway's legacy order-management application with agentic AI.
Give the merchandising team BI dashboards and AI agents that answer questions about sales, with no code.
Pick a pre-trained open model from an ML hub and deploy it to a SageMaker endpoint that Cairnway controls.
Save the product-description prompt as a template with variables, and keep versions so the team can roll back.
Compare three foundation models on Cairnway's own support questions, with an LLM-as-a-judge scoring the answers.
Write new descriptions for 200,000 catalog items overnight at a lower price than on-demand calls.
Serve the model that Cairnway fine-tuned in Bedrock to its live chat.
cards.why: The catalog notes that Provisioned Throughput is required to use a custom model in Bedrock.

cards.prompt: Handle traffic peaks on Black Friday by routing on-demand requests to other AWS Regions in the same geography.
Use foundation models built by Amazon itself, rather than by another model provider.
Chain a saved prompt, a knowledge-base lookup and a Lambda function into one multi-step generative AI workflow.
Block the refund agent from calling the refund tool for amounts over 500 dollars, with a rule kept outside the agent's code.
Check the shipping-policy assistant's answers against the written policy rules with formal logic, to catch incorrect statements.
Score how well a deployed agent picks and uses its tools, with LLM-as-a-judge evaluators.
cards.why: Bedrock Model Evaluation compares models. AgentCore Evaluations assesses agents, including their tool use.

cards.prompt: Let the order-lookup agent act on behalf of a signed-in customer, with credentials for each tool it calls.
